purpose: Controlled reimplementations informed by the three pinned repositories; not exact upstream reproductions
data: MNIST official training split; 28x28, [-1,1]; uniform class sampling
architecture: Identical conditional DigitUNet with global 7x7 attention
conditioning: 10 classes; guidance=1; no label dropout; no external classifier guidance

flow.path: independent linear interpolation, noise at t=0

followup_controls: Both reflow and continued-flow start from the same frozen base-flow EMA, same optimizer and update budget
limitations: One training seed; shared V100 hardware; reflow pair-generation cost reported separately
quality_diagnostics: within-class feature and pixel variance ratios
